transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer account services. My name is Toby. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Toby. I'm calling about our student shared house broadband contract. Our university academic year has finished and four of us are moving out of the flat this Friday, but one student is staying on for a postgraduate course and wants to take over the broadband in her name so we don't get hit with early termination fees.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly advise on the account novation process. Can you please confirm the landline telephone number associated with the broadband service?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And what is your student union registration ID number or university electronic mail domain?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My student ID is LUU-882109. Toby, this whole situation has become an absolute nightmare! Two of my flatmates have had a vicious falling-out, packed their bags, and left without paying their final share of the broadband and utility bills! The landlord is threatening to confiscate our entire eight-hundred-pound housing deposit if all utility contracts aren't cleared or transferred by Friday noon! I am completely stressed out and have been crying all morning because I cannot afford to lose my deposit money!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Account novation transfers all contractual billing rights and obligations from the outgoing account holder to the incoming nominee.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How do we transfer the contract to the student who is staying?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I have understood correctly, your student tenancy is ending this Friday with four housemates departing, and you need the active broadband contract transferred to the remaining postgraduate tenant to avoid early termination charges and clear your landlord obligations. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly what we need to accomplish before Friday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: S-Net is not an estate agent or arbitrator; dividing bills among flatmates is strictly your private house dispute and S-Net holds zero responsibility for non-paying roommates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am not asking you to chase my flatmates! I just want to transfer the contract into the remaining student's name!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under our terms, account transfers require an electronic Change of Tenancy form signed by both parties.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What is the incoming student's name and details needed for the form?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please provide the incoming tenant's full legal name, date of birth, mobile telephone number, and electronic mail contact details.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Her name is Priya Patel, born twelfth of May 2002, mobile 07700 900642, and electronic mail priya.patel@leeds.ac.uk.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have created the incoming customer profile for Priya Patel on the billing CRM.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does Priya have to pass a credit check?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Change of Tenancy transfers on continuing broadband contracts perform a soft identity check with zero impact on credit scores.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is a big relief because student credit histories are usually very thin.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What is the exact target date for the account handover?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Friday the twenty-eighth of June, at twelve noon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The transfer date is scheduled for twelve hundred hours on the twenty-eighth of June.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What happens to the current S-Net Hub router in the hallway? Does Priya get to keep using it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hardware remains on-site under equipment novation; Priya inherits the existing Hub 5 and zero service interruption occurs.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So the WiFi won't disconnect or reboot when the transfer happens?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Routing and DSL line sync remain continuously active; only the billing ledger identity changes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will Priya keep the existing wireless network name and password on the Hub 5 router?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The wireless SSID credentials and encryption keys stored in flash memory remain completely unchanged during account novation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That means her smart TV, wireless printer, and tablet will stay connected automatically without retyping passwords.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All connected DHCP client leases will transition seamlessly across the billing boundary.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What about aligning her direct debit date with her student maintenance loan installments?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Priya can configure her recurring payment collection date on any calendar day between the first and twenty-eighth of each month.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Student Finance England pays loans in late September, January, and April, so setting payment on the first will suit her perfectly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have designated the default billing collection day as the first of each calendar month.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does Priya qualify for a student discount tariff as a continuing postgraduate?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under our University Care programme, validating a student union card provides a five-pound monthly discount on standard fiber tariffs.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Priya has her NUS Totum card ready, so she can attach that to her online profile.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What happens to the final bill for June? Who is responsible for that?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, how is the June bill split between me and Priya?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A pro-rata closing bill will be calculated for your period of occupancy up to midday Friday and sent to your electronic mail.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I get an official statement confirming the account handover to show our landlord so he releases our deposit?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can generate an official 'Notice of Tenancy Novation' PDF letter addressed to your tenancy reference.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please email that letter right away so I can forward it to the letting agency.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The tenancy novation confirmation letter has been dispatched to your registered electronic mail.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Checking my inbox... yes, the PDF has arrived with S-Net letterhead! That will satisfy the landlord completely!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously that confirms your tenancy deposit compliance obligation is formally documented on official corporate records.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Now what does Priya need to do to complete her side of the setup?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Priya will receive a secure DocuSign link via email to enter her bank account sort code and direct debit mandate.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long does she have to sign the DocuSign link?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The electronic authorization link remains active for seventy-two hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will tell Priya to look out for that email this afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check the broadband sync rate on the Leeds street cabinet to ensure the connection has no line errors.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How is the speed looking from your end?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The VDSL line is synchronized at seventy-six megabits per second download and nineteen megabits upload with zero packet dropouts.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The speed has always been rock-solid for streaming lectures and coursework.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The SNR noise margin is six point four decibels, indicating clean copper loop parameters.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does Priya need to return the router if she relocates after her master's degree?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If she moves out next summer, she can either transfer service to a new tenancy or return the Hub using a prepaid Royal Mail bag.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will leave the original router box in the hallway cupboard for her.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to reconfirm, the incoming tenant's electronic mail contact is priya.patel@leeds.ac.uk, under mobile 07700 900642.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, priya.patel@leeds.ac.uk. That is completely correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also record your parental home location for any final postal correspondence or closing account certificates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My parents' house is 5 Elmfield Terrace, York, YO31 1AA.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have updated your future correspondence file on the outgoing customer profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will my online S-Net account login remain active so I can view past bills?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your online customer portal account remains accessible in read-only mode for twelve months following contract transfer.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is very useful for tax and student records.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If Priya fails to sign the mandate, do not contact S-Net as ensuring roommate compliance is strictly your own private problem.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Priya is my best friend, she won't fail to sign it. But there is no need to be so unhelpful.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, Toby, before we finish, what if Priya wants to upgrade the broadband speed to...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: She can deal with that after the transfer. Thank you for choosing S-Net. Have a good day. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, Toby, don't hang up... hello? He hung up!
